Fixture provenance
==================

- `router-status.json`: sanitized captured `campaign/qwen/rep/runs/r3/status-prod-router.json`.
  Replica ids/nodes and endpoints were replaced with `halo-1`, `halo-2` and
  documentation addresses. All counter and health values were retained.
- `engine-status.json`: sanitized captured `campaign/qwen/rep/runs/r3/status-prod-c1.json`.
  Four recent requests were retained. Request ids and timestamps were replaced,
  and the engine description shortened. Timing/token measurements were retained.
- `router-metrics.txt`: generated by the pinned router's `_metrics_text` from
  the sanitized router data. The formatter ignores prefill data.
- `router-services.json`: captured router data with a synthetic prefill service,
  placements and pending work using `ServicePool.snapshot` field names.
- `deepseek-status.json`: synthetic, from `src/serve/api.cpp::status` and
  `apps/deepseek41_serve_main.cpp::config.status_extra`. Memory and trellis
  identity are nested under `memory`; pool fields are nested under `slots`.
- `engine-metrics.txt`: synthetic, using exactly the metric names in
  `src/serve/api.cpp::metrics` and the DeepSeek `config.metrics_extra`.
- `prefill-health.json`, `prefill-progress.json`, `prefill-describe.json`:
  synthetic, from `apps/cuda_ds41_prefill_service_main.cu::health/describe`.
  The empty inner `describe` object is deliberately partial: this adapter
  preserves that component-owned object without inventing its contents.
  No matching prefill capture was found in the searched campaign/hetero files.

The pinned prefill endpoints do not emit schema ids. Their adapter accepts the
current unversioned shape, reports that limitation in `why["schema"]`, and
rejects any explicit schema until a versioned component contract is supported.
Optional/unsupported telemetry is represented by None plus a field-path reason.
